title: AI-DLC keep-alive settings
description: Settings of the ai-dlc plugin's keep-alive (Claude Code only), committed in .ai-dlc/cache-keepalive.json. Each key is read, highest first, from a /ai-dlc:cache-keepalive override (keep-warm times only, per track), the env of .claude/settings.local.json (its x-env variable), the env of .claude/settings.json, this file, then the default. Keep-alive has no /config rows, and the process environment is not read. null means not set here: the next source applies. An invalid value, or one that breaks a rule (a duration shorter than minDuration, a pingEvery not shorter than its track's ttl), is logged and the next source applies. Keys marked x-trustGated apply from this file and from the env of .claude/settings.json only when Claude Code trusts the folder (projects[<repository root>].hasTrustDialogAccepted in ~/.claude.json); elsewhere they are skipped and logged with their values. /ai-dlc:cache-keepalive-config shows and changes them.

enabled.description: Keep-alive on or off. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

scope.description: The scope of /ai-dlc:cache-keepalive <duration> without a flag: session or machine.

pingPrompt.default: Keep-alive ping. Reply with only: ok
pingPrompt.description: The text each ping sends. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

hitThreshold.description: A ping is a hit when more than this share of its input, 0 up to 1, was read from the cache.

overagePercent.description: No pings while any plan usage window is at or above this percent, 1 to 100.

minDuration.description: The shortest duration accepted from your settings and the command (at least 1 second). Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d.

oneHour.description: The 1h track: used when the session's cache is written with the 1-hour lifetime.

enabled.description: The 1h track on or off. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

ttl.description: The lifetime the 1h track assumes after each ping. Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d.

pingEvery.description: The 1h track's interval. Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

keepWarmFor.description: How long the 1h track keeps pinging. Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

maxPings.description: The 1h track's ping limit; 0 is none. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

fiveMinute.description: The 5m track: used when the session's cache is written with the 5-minute lifetime.

enabled.description: The 5m track on or off. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

ttl.description: The lifetime the 5m track assumes after each ping. Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d.

pingEvery.description: The 5m track's interval. Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

keepWarmFor.description: How long the 5m track keeps pinging. Written <n>m, <n>h or <n>d. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

maxPings.description: The 5m track's ping limit; 0 is none (the hour allows 20 pings). From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

budgetMultiplier.description: The spend limit, in multiples of the context's tokens; 0 turns it off. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

compactOnCap.description: Compact instead of stopping when the spend limit is reached. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

compactInstructions.default: Also keep the background tasks' IDs, output paths, and what to do when they finish.
compactInstructions.description: What that compaction is told to keep. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

writeMult.description: A cache write's price over the base input price. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

outputMult.description: An output token's price over the base input price. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

readPrice.description: A cache read's price over the base input price, by model: pattern=multiplier pairs, the first pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression) that matches the model id wins, * for any other. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

compactCostGuess.description: A compaction's cost per context token, until one has been measured.

summaryRatioGuess.description: A compaction summary's size over the context, until one has been measured.
